description: The Cuemon.Extensions.AspNetCore.Mvc namespace contains both types and extension methods that complements the Cuemon.AspNetCore.Mvc namespace while being an addition to the Microsoft.AspNetCore.Mvc namespace. Provides a set of different cache busting strategies for ASP.NET Core MVC that can be easily customized.
